description: Per-bucket S3 usage and performance analytics. Usage metrics show stored bytes/objects per bucket. Performance metrics show per-bucket operation throughput and latency.

panels.description: Total bytes stored in the selected bucket (usage metric).
panels.title: Stored Bytes

panels.description: Total compressed bytes stored in the selected bucket (usage metric).
panels.title: Utilized Bytes

panels.description: Total number of objects in the selected bucket (usage metric).
panels.title: Stored Objects

panels.description: Total bytes stored in the selected bucket over time. Source: usage metric (gauge).
panels.title: Stored Bytes Over Time

panels.description: Total object count in the selected bucket over time. Source: usage metric.
panels.title: Object Count Over Time

panels.description: PUT bytes from per-bucket performance counter (cumulative, not stored capacity).

targets.expr:
sum by (bucket, ceph_daemon) ((ceph_rgw_op_per_bucket_put_obj_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"}) *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

panels.title: PUT Bytes (Performance)

panels.description: GET bytes from per-bucket performance counter.

targets.expr:
sum by (bucket, ceph_daemon) ((ceph_rgw_op_per_bucket_get_obj_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"}) *
    on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon) ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_servers", cluster=~"$cluster|", })

panels.title: GET Bytes (Performance)
